info.title: Benefits Platform Communications API
info.description: The Benefits Platform is a long-term project which will eventually unify the benefits logic from all health applications.

get.description: Retrieves a specific document identified by the given document ID for the specified Consumer. Use the request header 'accept: application/json' for the PDF Byte array, or 'accept: application/pdf' for the PDF file.

parameters.name: person_id
parameters.description: Unique Person Identifier obtained by looking up a Consumer in the Benefits Platform Identity System.

parameters.name: document_id
parameters.description: Unique Document Identifier.

parameters.name: X-Request-Id
parameters.description: Optional correlation ID associated with the request, comprised of alphanumeric or hyphen characters up to 36 characters in length.

404.description: The specified ID was not found on Database.

get.description: Retrieves a specific message identified by the given message ID for the specified Consumer.

parameters.name: person_id
parameters.description: Unique Person Identifier obtained by looking up a Consumer in the Benefits Platform Identity System.

parameters.name: message_id
parameters.description: Unique Message Identifier.

parameters.name: X-Request-Id
parameters.description: Optional correlation ID associated with the request, comprised of alphanumeric or hyphen characters up to 36 characters in length.

404.description: The specified ID was not found on Database.

put.description: Replaces the message for the specified ID with the data in the request body.

parameters.name: person_id
parameters.description: Unique Person Identifier obtained by looking up a Consumer in the Benefits Platform Identity System.

parameters.name: message_id
parameters.description: Unique Message Identifier.

parameters.name: X-Request-Id
parameters.description: Optional correlation ID associated with the request, comprised of alphanumeric or hyphen characters up to 36 characters in length.

404.description: The message with the specified ID does not exist.

get.description: Retrieves a list of messages associated with the specified Consumer. Messages are sorted by their created_date.

parameters.name: person_id
parameters.description: Unique Person Identifier obtained by looking up a Consumer in the Benefits Platform Identity System.

parameters.name: start_date
parameters.description: The start of the date range. Default is 3 years ago.

parameters.name: end_date
parameters.description: The end of the date range. Default is now.

parameters.name: read
parameters.description: Filter for read status of messages.

parameters.name: archived
parameters.description: Filter for archived status of messages.

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: The number of records returned at once. Can be from 1-100, default is 25.

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: The current page index of the message records. Index starts at 0.

parameters.name: X-Request-Id
parameters.description: Optional correlation ID associated with the request, comprised of alphanumeric or hyphen characters up to 36 characters in length.

404.description: The specified ID was not found on Database.

get.description: This endpoint is used to check the liveness of the service. This is just a simple ping to see if the service is alive.

CommunicationDeliveryType.description: The type of communication delivery method (e.g., SMS).

document_id.description: The unique identifier for an attached document.

name.description: The name of the attached document.

Document.description: Document Object containing details of a document.

message_id.description: The unique identifier for the message.

subject.description: The subject line or title of the message.

content.description: The body content of the message.

created_date.description: The timestamp when the message was created.

read.description: Indicates whether the message has been marked as read by the receiver.

acknowledged_date.description: The timestamp when the message was acknowledged by the receiver, if applicable.

archived.description: Indicates whether the message has been archived.

sender.description: The identifier or name of the message sender.

receiver.description: The identifier or name of the message receiver.

Message.description: Message Object containing details of a message.

index.description: The current page number in the paginated results.

page_size.description: The number of items returned per page in the results.

has_next.description: Indicates if there are additional pages of results.

Messages.description: Messages Object containing a list of messages and pagination information.

NotificationCategoryType.description: The category associated with the notification preferences (e.g., CLAIMS).

name.description: The name of the notification preference.

configurations.description: A list of delivery methods and their settings.

preferences.description: A list of detailed notification preference configurations for a person.

category_description.description: A description of the notification preference category.

NotificationPreferenceCategory.description: A list of notification preference categories.

NotificationPreferenceType.description: The type of notification preference (e.g., HSA_ACCOUNT_SUMMARY).

enabled.description: Indicates whether this delivery method is enabled.

opted_in.description: Indicates whether the person has opted in for notifications through this delivery method.

contents.description: The encoded contents of the document as a byte array.

mime_type.description: The MIME type of the document, indicating its format. Currently only application/pdf is supported.

content_length.description: The size of the document in bytes.

RenderedDocument.description: Document Object containing details of a Document.

value.description: The threshold value for the notification trigger.
